SessionStart._comment: Inject current workflow progress into session context.
Inject configured hardware targets into session context. Re-injects on resume/clear/compact so hardware awareness survives compaction.

Notification._comment: Desktop notification when Claude finishes work or needs input. Cross-platform.

PostToolUse._comment: After each Bash call during optimization, validate that metric was parseable if this was an experiment run.
Validates research agent output structure after state file writes.

hooks.command: bash -c 'TOOL="$TOOL_NAME"; INPUT="$TOOL_INPUT"; if [ "$TOOL" = "Write" ]; then FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o ".harness/research-[^\"]*\.json" || true); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\"); const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"$FILE\",\"utf8\")); const o=s.output||{}; const errs=[]; if(o.results&&!Array.isArray(o.results))errs.push(\"results must be array\"); if(o.findings&&!Array.isArray(o.findings))errs.push(\"findings must be array\"); if(o.recommendations&&!Array.isArray(o.recommendations))errs.push(\"recommendations must be array\"); if(o.tradeoff_matrix&&!Array.isArray(o.tradeoff_matrix))errs.push(\"tradeoff_matrix must be array\"); if(errs.length){console.error(\"Research output validation:\",errs.join(\", \"));process.exit(1)}" 2>&1; fi; fi'

PreCompact._comment: Before context compaction, flush optimizer state summary to stdout so baseline/best/recent-history survive the compaction summary.
